summary: Correct the first supporting whistling reference from verse 5 to verse 4
rationale: The main quotation is correctly at 116/17. Of the additional references, 96/5 contains greetings and no whistling verb; the immediately preceding 96/4 has gmašrəq in the pipe-smoking scene. Verse 96/18 has kmašrəq in the same scene and remains valid. These are supporting attestations, not an alternative location for the whole 116/17 quotation.
